name: zzbd_section_handler_list_swap
description: zZbdSectionHandlerList::Swap exchanges sentinel and count fields between two section-handler lists.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD STL-list helper pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c0ba0 validates swapping the sentinel pointer at offset 4 and count at offset 8 between two list headers.
The native smoke swaps two one-node lists and verifies the visible node ownership and counts are exchanged.
